post.description: To show a field on a given date. Get the scene id from search_scenes. Sizes grow with the geometry: keep max_px small for large fields.

collection.description:
Collection of the scene id; inferred from the id form when omitted.

Provider reference: allowed values ["sentinel-2-c1-l2a", "sentinel-2-l2a"].

geometry.description: GeoJSON geometry in WGS84 with [lon, lat] positions: Point, Polygon, MultiPolygon, or a Feature wrapping one. Rings must be closed; altitude is ignored; FeatureCollection and antimeridian-crossing shapes are refused (invalid_input with a JSON pointer and a stable code: ring_not_closed, latitude, longitude, too_large, too_many_vertices, feature_collection, antimeridian, unsupported_type). Open because GeoJSON allows foreign members (properties, id, bbox).

layer.description:
`true_colour` (default) reads the visual asset; `ndvi` reads red and nir.

Provider reference: allowed values ["true_colour", "ndvi"].

max_px.description:
Longest side of the PNG; the native clip is enlarged by the largest whole factor that fits.

Provider reference: minimum 16; maximum 1024; default 512.

scene_id.description: Earth Search item id, e.g. S2B_T16SDE_20260903T163711_L2A (sentinel-2-c1-l2a) or S2A_16SDE_20220909_0_L2A (sentinel-2-l2a). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$.

collection.description:
`sentinel-2-c1-l2a` (Collection 1, default), `sentinel-2-l2a` (legacy archive, denser before 2023) or `auto` (c1, falling back to the legacy collection when c1 matches nothing).

Open because GeoJSON allows foreign members (properties, id, bbox).

max_cloud_cover_pct.description:
Keep scenes whose tile-level eo:cloud_cover is below this percentage (Earth Search `query` filter).
